abstract:
We resolve vertical and global slope stability for 1-step extensions on automorphic K3 products and construct globally slope-stable vector bundles realizing primitive rational Hodge similarities of nonsquare prime multipliers p = 3 and p = 2.

First, we prove the Syzygy Destabilization Theorem: any 1-step diagonal-coboundary extension of 2-twist evaluation bundles with equal u_1-degree a >= 3 and b_i >= a + 2 (including E_33 and E_57) is vertically unstable on every fiber via a two-point syzygy subsheaf and a Lazarsfeld-Mukai subbundle. Second, applying the Pragacz-Srinivas-Pati diagonal construction and Hartshorne-Serre correspondence to the acyclic (-4)-divisor L_0 = O(u_1 - 2u_2), we construct a rank-2 bundle U_0 on X_0 = S_0 x S_0 and prove the Two-Wall Chamber Theorem: across Amp(S_0), the Bogomolov-Mukai identity yields only two walls y/x in {2, 4}, making U_0|_y stable in C_2 = (2, 4) and U_0|_x stable in C_1 = (1, 2). Third, under wall clearance m(H_1) >= 2 (E_4) and m(H_1) >= 3 (E_6), we establish Two-Polarization Base Change, a 3-step sheaf-theoretic base-change proof at A = (1, -3), the Filtration Subsheaf h^0-Bound Lemma, global slope stability of E_4 and E_6 (Variants I-IV), and primitive similarity M^* M = 3 id_21 in Variant IV.

On the coupled tower B_9 subset B_18 subset B_19, Grauert base change gives the relative algebraic family over U_9' subset B_9, while the Parabolic Atiyah Algebroid Diagram bounds first-order normal unobstructed directions by min_bullet h^2(V_{A_bullet} tensor N_bullet) (= 0 in Variants I, III, IV). Finally, local Koszul pullback saturation for g_6 = g_3 o iota (p = 3) and g_4 on S_0^{(4)} (p = 2) yields globally slope-stable bundles E_8^{(6)} and E_8^{(4)} for m(H_1) >= 4.

(2) Exceptional case A = (1, -3) in Theorem 4.1(3) Steps (a)-(c): In Step (a), replaced the smooth-fiber genus-1 degree argument with an exact 2 x 3 commutative diagram on S_0 whose middle term L_0 = O_{S_0}(s - f) is completely acyclic (H^*(S_0, L_0) = 0), identifying (partial_y)^v = iota_{1*} with point evaluation ev_y|_{F_y} on H^0(F_y, O_{F_y}(s - f)) = C . (1_s|_{F_y}) across every scheme-theoretic fiber F_y (smooth or singular); in Step (c), corrected the dual twist Hom_{S_0}(F_1, O_{S_0}(-2u_2)) = F_1^v(-2f) = U_0|_y(3f) (matching Step (a) rather than U_0|_y(f)), so tau_{pi(y)} in H^0(S_0, I_y(f)) lifts globally to tilde{tau}_y in H^0(S_0, U_0|_y(3f)) for y in s with ev_y(tilde{tau}_y) = [1; 0] != [0; 0]. (3) Uniform section-count bound B(A, N) in Theorems 4.1(3) and 9.1(3): Replaced the invalid fiberwise inequality with induction along the section restriction sequence 0 -> O_{S_0}((k-1)s + bf) -> O_{S_0}(ks + bf) -> O_s(b - 2k) -> 0, proving h^0(S_0, d_1 s + bf) <= (d_1 + 1)(b + 1) = (d_1 + 1)(d_1 + d_2 + 1) and B(A, N) = (a_1 + n_1 + 4)(n_1 + n_2 + 2), with chi - 2B(A, N) >= 82 > 0 (Theorem 4.1(3)) and >= 76 - L(g) >= 62 > 0 (Theorem 9.1(3)). (4) Theorem 8.1(2), Theorem 9.1, and exposition: Added a self-contained 4-step Dolbeault/Chern-Weil/Griffiths infinitesimal-period proof of At_0(Q_{1,bullet}) . kappa(xi) = 0 => obs_{3,1}(Q_{1,bullet})(xi) = 0 => xi = 0 in Theorem 8.1(2); cleanly separated theorem statements from proofs in Sections 8 and 9; corrected the (1, 2) slope bound for E_4|_y to (1 - m)/6 <= -1/6, Remark 5.2's m = 1, 2 wording, dim B_vert, dim B_horiz <= 1, and Theorem 7.1's first-order obstruction equivalence wording; and replaced '[PROVED]' labels in all four supplement scripts with '[VERIFIED]'.
title: Slope-Stable Serre–Hartshorne Vector Bundles for Multipliers p in {2, 3} on Automorphic K3 Products: The Two-Wall Chamber Theorem, Punctual Fixed-Locus Base Change, and Parabolic Atiyah Obstructions
